youtube.baslik: In a high-frequency dead region, how far can gain help? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The frequency at the boundary where a dead region begins is called the edge frequency. In people with high-frequency dead regions, gain up to about 1.7 times the edge frequency has been shown to be useful; gain placed deeper may not help some people and may even distort the sound. However, some studies report that hearing aid users with dead regions can still benefit from high-frequency gain, so the decision is individual and rests on verification.
